sampling: Seed 5500: random-phase systematic thinning throughout every original Parquet part. OSM: retain approximately one in 1,000 records; Census: one in 200. More spatially dispersed than a first-batch extract, but record order can still induce bias. These remain teaching samples, not validated inferential survey samples.
taxi_sampling: First 150,000 rows from a historical January 2015 Parquet row group; coordinate and timestamp columns only; hours derived from timestamps to avoid obsolete Parquet integer encoding.
parking_sampling: First 10,000 CSV records; only original latitude and longitude retained. Not a uniform/time-representative sample.
